title: Resolve planning identities
responsibility: Find a plan folder by unit identity and verify its relationship to a canonical unit manifest.

inputs.name: identity.unitId
inputs.description: Dotted lowercase unit ID to validate; maximum 200 characters.

inputs.name: attest.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: attest.unit
inputs.description: Unit ID and category that the manifest must match.

inputs.name: planFiles.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planFiles.rev
inputs.description: Revision whose plan files are listed.

inputs.name: findIdentity.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planIdentity.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: planIdentity.unitId
inputs.description: Unit ID that must have a plan.

inputs.name: validateIdentity.git
inputs.description: Repository handle with root, Git directory and command runner.

inputs.name: validateIdentity.rev
inputs.description: Revision containing the plan and any canonical manifest.

inputs.name: validateIdentity.plan
inputs.description: Plan identity, category and slug to verify.

outputs.name: identity
outputs.description: Returns nothing for a valid dotted identity.

outputs.name: attest
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the canonical manifest ID and kind match the plan.

outputs.name: planFiles
outputs.description: Plan metadata paths in supported category folders.

outputs.name: findIdentity
outputs.description: Matching plan folder or null; duplicate matching identities are refused.

outputs.name: planIdentity
outputs.description: Matching plan folder; absence is refused.

outputs.name: validateIdentity
outputs.description: Returns nothing when the identity resolves to its expected category/slug folder and any canonical identity is attested.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: Rejects invalid identities, missing plans, duplicate or mismatched identities and failed artifact reads.
